trouble.title: Troubleshooting
trouble.subtitle: The problems from the Dortania troubleshooting pages, by the stage where they happen. Search for the message you see on screen.
trouble.search: Search an error message or symptom (e.g. EXITBS, Waiting for Root Device, iMessage)
trouble.only_relevant: Only problems specific to my hardware
trouble.no_efi: Open an EFI in the Post-Install tab first, then come back to apply the fix.
postinstall.title: Post-Install
postinstall.subtitle: Optional changes from the Dortania Post-Install guide, applied to an EFI you already built. Every change keeps a backup of config.plist and is checked with ocvalidate.
postinstall.no_efi: Pick the folder of an EFI built by EasyOpenCore (or the EFI folder on your USB drive or ESP) to see its current settings.
postinstall.done: Saved. The previous config.plist was backed up to {0}
postinstall.validation.failed: ocvalidate found problems — check the output below (the backup can be copied back to OC/config.plist)
postinstall.error.no_config: No EFI with OC/config.plist was found in {0}.
postinstall.error.unknown_oc: This EFI's OpenCore.efi does not match any OpenCore release EasyOpenCore can download, so matching binaries can't be fetched. Rebuild the EFI in the Build EFI tab.
tweak.verbose.title: Verbose boot (-v)
tweak.verbose.detail: Shows the kernel log instead of the Apple logo while macOS boots. Keep it on until the system is stable; turning it off is the first step of the guide's clean-up.
tweak.debug_args.title: Keep kernel panic details (keepsyms=1 debug=0x100)
tweak.debug_args.detail: Prints symbols on kernel panics and stops the machine from rebooting by itself, so you can read or photograph the panic.
tweak.apple_debug.title: boot.efi debug output
tweak.apple_debug.detail: Misc → Debug → AppleDebug and ApplePanic. Useful while installing; the guide turns them off afterwards.
tweak.debug_log.title: OpenCore debug log
tweak.debug_log.detail: Swaps BOOTx64.efi, OpenCore.efi and the drivers for the DEBUG build of the same release and sets Target 67, so OpenCore writes opencore-*.txt logs to the EFI partition. Turning it off restores the RELEASE files.
tweak.gui.title: Graphical boot picker (OpenCanopy)
tweak.gui.detail: Adds OpenCanopy.efi and the GoldenGate icon set from OcBinaryData, with mouse support (PickerMode External, PickerAttributes 17).
tweak.chime.title: Boot chime
tweak.chime.detail: Plays the Mac startup sound through the onboard audio (AudioDxe.efi on the same controller as the AppleALC layout-id). USB DACs and HDMI audio don't work.
tweak.chime.unavailable: No onboard audio controller with a layout-id in this EFI.
tweak.hidpi.title: HiDPI boot screens
tweak.hidpi.detail: UIScale 2 with the maximum resolution: sharper picker, Apple logo and FileVault login on high-resolution screens.
tweak.hide_aux.title: Hide auxiliary entries
tweak.hide_aux.detail: Hides Recovery, Reset NVRAM and the tools in the picker. Press Space in the picker to show them.
tweak.launcher_option.title: Boot without the USB drive (LauncherOption)
tweak.launcher_option.detail: After you copy the EFI to the disk's EFI partition, OpenCore registers its own firmware boot entry, so Windows updates can't take over BOOTx64.efi. Uses "Short" on Insyde firmware.
tweak.skip_picker.title: Boot the default entry without the picker
tweak.skip_picker.detail: ShowPicker off: boots the default entry right away. Hold Esc or Option while booting to see the picker.
tweak.advise_features.title: Allow changing the startup disk
tweak.advise_features.detail: PlatformInfo → Generic → AdviseFeatures. Fixes "You can't change the startup disk to the selected disk" when Windows' EFI partition is not the first on the drive.
tweak.scan_policy.title: Only scan internal macOS drives (ScanPolicy)
tweak.scan_policy.detail: ScanPolicy 0x10F0103 instead of 0: only APFS/HFS volumes on internal drives are listed. USB installers, Windows and Linux entries are hidden — leave off when you multiboot.
tweak.secure_boot_off.title: Disable Apple Secure Boot
tweak.secure_boot_off.detail: SecureBootModel Disabled. Needed for "Security Violation" errors, unsigned kexts, OCLP root patches and macOS older than Catalina.
tweak.sip_off.title: Disable SIP (kext signing and filesystem protection)
tweak.sip_off.detail: csr-active-config 03000000. Only when a tool asks for it; with SIP off, macOS updates can fail.
tweak.rtc_checksum.title: Stop BIOS resets after shutdown (DisableRtcChecksum)
tweak.rtc_checksum.detail: Blocks AppleRTC from writing RTC regions 0x58-0x59. Try it if the BIOS resets or macOS starts in safe mode after reboot or sleep; turn it off if it doesn't help.
tweak.jumpstart_hotplug.title: Load APFS on hot-plugged drives (JumpstartHotPlug)
tweak.jumpstart_hotplug.detail: Fix for "[EB|LD:OFS] Err(0xE)" when booting the Preboot volume.
tweak.release_usb.title: Release USB ownership from the firmware
tweak.release_usb.detail: UEFI → Quirks → ReleaseUsbOwnership. Fix for "Waiting for Root Device" when the BIOS has no XHCI/EHCI hand-off option.
tweak.npci.title: PCI configuration fix (npci=0x2000)
tweak.npci.detail: For hangs at "PCI Configuration Begins" when the BIOS has no Above 4G Decoding option. Don't combine with Above 4G.
tweak.igfxonln.title: Force the iGPU screens online (igfxonln=1)
tweak.igfxonln.detail: WhateverGreen fix for Coffee Lake and newer Intel iGPUs: black screen after boot or screens that don't wake from sleep.
tweak.igfxblr.title: Backlight registers fix (-igfxblr)
tweak.igfxblr.detail: Black screen on Coffee Lake and newer Intel laptops right after IOConsoleUsers.
tweak.agdpmod.title: AMD display fix (agdpmod=pikera)
tweak.agdpmod.detail: Black screen on AMD Navi (RX 5000/6000) cards after IOConsoleUsers. Also try another display output.
tweak.unfairgva.title: Hardware DRM on AMD (unfairgva=1)
tweak.unfairgva.detail: WhateverGreen fix for streaming DRM (Apple TV+, Netflix in Safari) on Big Sur and newer with a supported AMD card.
tweak.kext_CpuTscSync.title: CpuTscSync
tweak.kext_CpuTscSync.detail: Synchronizes the CPU timestamp counters. Fix for macOS freezing right before the login screen (Intel).
tweak.kext_NVMeFix.title: NVMeFix
tweak.kext_NVMeFix.detail: Power management and better compatibility for non-Apple NVMe drives; helps sleep and battery life.
tweak.kext_ECEnabler.title: ECEnabler
tweak.kext_ECEnabler.detail: Lets laptops read battery fields wider than 8 bits without patching the DSDT — fixes missing or wrong battery percentage.
tweak.kext_RestrictEvents.title: RestrictEvents
tweak.kext_RestrictEvents.detail: Hides the "Memory modules misconfigured" warning on the MacPro7,1 SMBIOS and shows the real CPU name.
ts.oc_black_screen.title: Black screen before the OpenCore picker
ts.oc_black_screen.cause: The firmware or OpenCore fails while loading the drivers, before anything is drawn.
ts.oc_black_screen.fix:
• Turn on the OpenCore debug log and read the last lines of the opencore-*.txt file on the USB drive.
• No log at all: check the folder layout (EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.efi and EFI/OC/...).
• Stuck on HfsPlus.efi: use HfsPlusLegacy.efi on old CPUs without RDRAND.
• Stuck on HiiDatabase.efi: remove it, the firmware already has it.
ts.oc_no_vault.title: Stuck on "no vault provided!" or "Invalid Vault mode"
ts.oc_no_vault.cause: Vault is enabled, or its value is misspelled (it is case-sensitive).
ts.oc_no_vault.fix:
• Set Misc → Security → Vault to "Optional" (capital O).
• If you already ran sign.command, replace OpenCore.efi with a fresh copy from the same release.
ts.oc_no_partitions.title: macOS partitions don't show up in the picker
ts.oc_no_partitions.cause: ScanPolicy filters the drive, the HFS+/APFS driver is missing, or the SATA mode is wrong.
ts.oc_no_partitions.fix:
• Set ScanPolicy to 0.
• Make sure HfsPlus.efi (or OpenHfsPlus.efi) is in OC/Drivers and in UEFI → Drivers.
• Set SATA mode to AHCI in the BIOS.
• Some HP machines need UEFI → Quirks → UnblockFsConnect.
• High Sierra 10.13.5 or older: UEFI → APFS → MinDate and MinVersion = -1.
ts.oc_no_boot_entries.title: "OcScanForBootEntries failure - Not Found" / "System has no boot entries"
ts.oc_no_boot_entries.cause: No drive passes the current ScanPolicy.
ts.oc_no_schema.title: "OCS: No schema for DSDT, KernelAndKextPatch, SMBIOS..."
ts.oc_no_schema.cause: A Clover config, an old config from an earlier OpenCore, or one edited by a configurator app.
ts.oc_no_schema.fix: • Start again from a config made for this OpenCore version (rebuild the EFI here) and remove the unknown keys.
ts.oc_driver_missing.title: "OC: Driver XXX.efi at 0 cannot be found"
ts.oc_driver_missing.cause: UEFI → Drivers lists a file that is not in EFI/OC/Drivers.
ts.oc_driver_missing.fix: • Make the list and the folder match exactly — names are case-sensitive.
ts.oc_cant_select.title: The keyboard doesn't work in the picker
ts.oc_cant_select.cause: An incompatible keyboard driver, or a PS/2 keyboard without its driver.
ts.oc_cant_select.fix:
• Try UEFI → Input → KeySupport on, PollAppleHotKeys off, without OpenUsbKbDxe.
• If that fails, do the opposite: KeySupport off and add OpenUsbKbDxe.efi.
• Laptops with a PS/2 keyboard: add Ps2KeyboardDxe.efi.
ts.oc_reboots_bios.title: Selecting OpenCore reboots back to the BIOS
ts.oc_reboots_bios.cause: The EFI folder is in the wrong place or has the wrong structure.
ts.oc_reboots_bios.fix: • The drive must be FAT32 with EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.efi and EFI/OC/OpenCore.efi at its root (the USB installer in this app does this).
ts.oc_openruntime.title: "OCABC: Incompatible OpenRuntime r4, require r10"
ts.oc_openruntime.cause: BOOTx64.efi, OpenCore.efi and OpenRuntime.efi come from different OpenCore releases.
ts.oc_openruntime.fix: • Use all three files from the same release and build type (rebuild the EFI, or toggle the debug log here, which always swaps them together).
ts.oc_access_denied.title: "Failed to open OpenCore image - Access Denied"
ts.oc_access_denied.cause: Newer Microsoft Surface firmware blocks unsigned images even with Secure Boot off.
ts.oc_sb_model.title: "OC: Failed to find SB model disable halting on critical error"
ts.oc_sb_model.cause: A typo in Misc → Security → SecureBootModel.
ts.oc_sb_model.fix: • Set SecureBootModel to Disabled (or a valid value).
ts.k_exitbs.title: Stuck on [EB|#LOG:EXITBS:START] or EndRandomSeed
ts.k_exitbs.cause: Almost always the Booter quirks or the kernel patches don't fit the firmware, so the kernel never takes over.
ts.k_exitbs.fix:
• Turn on the OpenCore debug log to see where it stops.
• Check Booter → Quirks for your platform: DevirtualiseMmio, SetupVirtualMap (off on B550/A520, late X570/B450, Ice Lake and Comet Lake), and the memory-protection trio (EnableWriteUnprotector vs RebuildAppleMemoryMap + SyncRuntimePermissions, depending on MAT support in the log).
• AMD: the AMD Vanilla patches must match your core count (this app fills them in).
• Intel: AppleXcpmCfgLock / AppleCpuPmCfgLock when CFG-Lock can't be turned off in the BIOS.
ts.k_frame_pointer.title: Kernel panic "Invalid frame pointer"
ts.k_frame_pointer.cause: Same family as EXITBS: the Booter quirks don't fit the firmware memory map.
ts.k_frame_pointer.fix: • Review DevirtualiseMmio, SetupVirtualMap and the write-protection quirks as in the EXITBS entry.
ts.k_preboot.title: Stuck on [EB|LD:OFS] Err(0xE) booting the Preboot volume
ts.k_preboot.cause: The Preboot volume was not updated.
ts.k_preboot.fix:
• Turn on UEFI → APFS → JumpstartHotPlug.
• In Recovery → Terminal: find Preboot with diskutil list, mount it, then run diskutil apfs updatePreboot on it.
ts.k_security_violation.title: "OCB: LoadImage failed - Security Violation"
ts.k_security_violation.cause: Apple Secure Boot is on, but the Preboot volume lacks the Secure Boot manifests (a macOS bug).
ts.k_security_violation.fix:
• Disable Apple Secure Boot (SecureBootModel Disabled).
• Or reinstall the latest macOS, or copy /usr/standalone/i386 into the Preboot UUID folder's System/Library/CoreServices.
ts.k_memory_pool.title: "Memory pool allocation failure" or "Buffer Too Small"
ts.k_memory_pool.fix:
• Enable Above 4G Decoding.
• Disable CSM ("Windows 8.1/10 UEFI mode" on some boards); a few laptops need CSM on instead.
• Update the BIOS (especially Z390 and HEDT).
ts.k_not_supported.title: "This version of Mac OS X is not supported on this platform"
ts.k_not_supported.cause: The SMBIOS model is not supported by that macOS version.
ts.k_not_supported.fix: • Rebuild the EFI for the version you are installing — the app picks a supported SMBIOS — or change SystemProductName to a model that macOS supports.
ts.k_pci_hang.title: Stuck on RTC, PCI Configuration Begins, HPET or "Previous Shutdown"
ts.k_pci_hang.cause: A missing EC/RTC fix, PCI resource allocation, IRQ conflicts or NVRAM problems.
ts.k_pci_hang.fix:
• Make sure the SSDTs the app generated (SSDT-EC/USBX, SSDT-AWAC or RTC0) are in OC/ACPI and enabled.
• Enable Above 4G Decoding; if the BIOS doesn't have it, use npci=0x2000 (never both).
• On 2020+ BIOS with Resizable BAR: Booter → Quirks → ResizeAppleGpuBars = 0.
• Older laptops: IRQ conflicts need SSDT-HPET from SSDTTime.
• Disable SATA hot-plug; avoid Samsung PM981 and Micron 2200S drives.
ts.k_b550.title: Stuck at ACPI table loading on B550 / A520
ts.k_b550.cause: These boards don't declare CPU objects the way macOS expects.
ts.k_b550.fix: • Add SSDT-CPUR (the app generates it for B550/A520). Don't use it on X570, B450 or A320.
ts.k_root_device.title: "Waiting for Root Device" or prohibited sign
ts.k_root_device.cause: Usually USB (more than 15 ports, firmware still owning the controller) or SATA.
ts.k_root_device.fix:
• Map the USB ports (USB Mapping tab) or try another port (USB 2 vs USB 3).
• Enable XHCI/EHCI hand-off in the BIOS, or turn on ReleaseUsbOwnership.
• SATA: AHCI mode; RAID and Intel RST aren't supported.
• AMD 15h/16h: XLNCUSBFix.kext.
ts.k_gpu_init.title: Stuck on or near IOConsoleUsers: gIOScreenLock
ts.k_gpu_init.cause: This is right before the GPU initializes, so it's a graphics problem.
ts.k_gpu_init.fix:
• The GPU must support UEFI (GTX 7xx / 2013 or newer); CSM off in the BIOS.
• Force PCIe 3.0 link speed.
• Intel iGPU: check AAPL,ig-platform-id and device-id (desktop UHD 630 may need 00009B3E); try -igfxmlr; Coffee Lake on 10.15.4+ needs igfxonln=1.
ts.k_laptop_black.title: Black screen on a laptop after IOConsoleUsers
ts.k_laptop_black.fix:
• SSDT-PNLF must be in OC/ACPI and enabled (the app generates it for laptops).
• Check the iGPU properties on PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x2,0x0).
• Coffee Lake and newer: add -igfxblr (or enable-backlight-registers-fix).
ts.k_navi_black.title: Black screen with an AMD Navi card (RX 5000/6000)
ts.k_navi_black.fix:
• Add agdpmod=pikera and try another display output.
• Or use the MacPro7,1 SMBIOS with agdpmod=ignore.
ts.k_kext_summary.title: Kernel panic "Cannot perform kext summary"
ts.k_kext_summary.cause: Wrong kext order, an executable path that doesn't match the kext, or the same kext listed twice.
ts.k_kext_summary.fix:
• Lilu first, then its plugins; master kexts before their plugins.
• Plist-only kexts (USB maps) have no ExecutablePath; the others need one.
• Keep only the first copy of a duplicated kext. Rebuilding the EFI fixes all three.
ts.k_mce.title: Kernel panic on AppleIntelMCEReporter
ts.k_mce.cause: Catalina and newer break with multi-socket CPUs, and some AMD boards report more than one.
ts.k_mce.fix: • Add AppleMCEReporterDisabler.kext (needed on AMD with the MacPro/iMacPro SMBIOS).
ts.k_cpu_pm.title: Kernel panic on AppleIntelCPUPowerManagement
ts.k_cpu_pm.cause: NullCPUPowerManagement is used, or (Penryn and older) HPET is disabled.
ts.k_cpu_pm.fix: • Remove NullCPUPowerManagement and turn on Kernel → Emulate → DummyPowerManagement (AMD EFIs from this app already do this).
ts.k_kextd_stall.title: "kextd stall[0]: AppleACPICPU"
ts.k_kextd_stall.cause: The SMC emulator is missing or broken.
ts.k_kextd_stall.fix: • Lilu and VirtualSMC must both be in the EFI and in Kernel → Add, Lilu first. Never use VirtualSMC and FakeSMC together.
ts.k_cckprng.title: Kernel panic on cckprng_int_gen
ts.k_cckprng.cause: Missing SMC emulator, or SSDT-CPUR used on a board that doesn't need it.
ts.k_cckprng.fix:
• Add VirtualSMC.
• SSDT-CPUR only on B550 and A520.
ts.k_cs_runtime.title: Stuck at "Forcing CS_RUNTIME for entitlement"
ts.k_cs_runtime.cause: macOS is sealing the system volume — this is normal.
ts.k_cs_runtime.fix: • Don't restart. It can take a long time.
ts.k_usb_reboot.title: Reboot on "AppleUSBHostPort::createDevice: failed to create device" (11.3+)
ts.k_usb_reboot.cause: XhciPortLimit no longer works on macOS 11.3 and newer.
ts.k_usb_reboot.fix: • Turn off Kernel → Quirks → XhciPortLimit and map the USB ports (USB Mapping tab).
ts.i_russian.title: The macOS installer is in Russian
ts.i_russian.cause: The sample config sets prev-lang:kbd to Russian.
ts.i_russian.fix:
• EFIs from this app already use en-US. Reset NVRAM in the picker so the old value is cleared.
• Elsewhere: set NVRAM prev-lang:kbd to 656e2d55533a30 (en-US:0).
• ThinkPads: update the BIOS instead of resetting NVRAM.
ts.i_damaged.title: "The macOS installer is damaged"
ts.i_damaged.cause: An old installer (before October 2019) with an expired certificate.
ts.i_damaged.fix: • Download a current installer, or disconnect the network and set the date from the Recovery terminal.
ts.i_frozen.title: Installer freezes after about 30 seconds
ts.i_frozen.cause: Power management: NullCPUPowerManagement is faulty or missing.
ts.i_frozen.fix: • Remove NullCPUPowerManagement and turn on Kernel → Emulate → DummyPowerManagement.
ts.i_frozen_login.title: macOS freezes right before the login screen
ts.i_frozen_login.cause: The CPU timestamp counters (TSC) are out of sync.
ts.i_mediakit.title: "MediaKit reports not enough space"
ts.i_mediakit.cause: Windows made a 100 MB EFI partition; macOS needs 200 MB.
ts.i_mediakit.fix: • Erase the whole drive in Disk Utility (View → Show All Devices) instead of a partition, or grow the EFI partition to 200 MB.
ts.i_erase.title: Disk Utility fails to erase
ts.i_erase.cause: Erasing a partition instead of the drive, a first-try bug, SATA hot-plug, old firmware or a faulty drive.
ts.i_erase.fix:
• Erase the whole drive and try twice.
• Disable SATA hot-plug; update the drive's firmware.
ts.i_sata.title: SATA drives don't show in Disk Utility
ts.i_sata.cause: SATA in RAID/IDE mode, or an unsupported controller.
ts.i_sata.fix:
• Set SATA to AHCI in the BIOS.
• Add CtlnaAHCIPort.kext (AHCIPortInjector.kext for very old controllers).
ts.i_two_minutes.title: Stuck at "2 minutes remaining"
ts.i_two_minutes.cause: macOS is writing NVRAM for the next boot, and NVRAM doesn't work.
ts.i_two_minutes.fix:
• Intel 300-series (Z390...): SSDT-PMC (the app adds it when needed).
• Others: emulated NVRAM (LegacyEnable, LegacyOverwrite and WriteFlash on).
ts.i_recovery_server.title: "The recovery server could not be contacted"
ts.i_recovery_server.cause: A recovery-based installer has to download macOS, and the network doesn't work.
ts.i_recovery_server.fix:
• Check Ethernet/Wi-Fi; if no network card shows up, the network kext is missing (see the Compatibility tab).
• Test with ping from the installer Terminal. If ping works, Apple's servers are the problem — try later.
ts.i_firmware_update.title: "Your Mac needs a firmware update to install to this volume"
ts.i_firmware_update.fix:
• PlatformInfo → Automatic on, UpdateSMBIOSMode Create (Dell and VAIO: Custom + CustomSMBIOSGuid).
• Use a supported SMBIOS and the latest OpenCore, without -no_compat_check.
ts.p_verbose.title: macOS still boots with text instead of the Apple logo
ts.p_verbose.cause: The build keeps verbose and debug output on for the first install.
ts.p_verbose.fix: • Once the system is stable, turn off verbose boot and the boot.efi debug output.
ts.p_without_usb.title: Booting without the USB drive
ts.p_without_usb.cause: OpenCore still lives on the USB installer.
ts.p_without_usb.fix:
• In macOS, mount the disk's EFI partition and copy the EFI folder into it.
• Turn on LauncherOption so the firmware gets its own OpenCore entry.
ts.p_imessage.title: iMessage, FaceTime or Siri don't work
ts.p_imessage.cause: Serial, MLB, ROM or en0 aren't set up the way Apple's servers expect.
ts.p_imessage.fix:
• The app generates a unique serial and uses your network card's MAC as ROM.
• Check the serial on Apple's Check Coverage page ("unable to check coverage" is what you want).
• en0 must be a built-in Ethernet or Wi-Fi port (check with Hackintool).
• NVRAM must work.
ts.p_audio.title: No onboard audio
ts.p_audio.cause: Wrong AppleALC layout-id for your codec.
ts.p_audio.fix: • Try the other layouts listed in the Build EFI tab with the boot-arg alcid=N, then put the working one in layout-id.
ts.p_cmos.title: BIOS resets or safe mode after reboot or shutdown
ts.p_cmos.cause: AppleRTC writes RTC regions the firmware doesn't like.
ts.p_cmos.fix:
• Try DisableRtcChecksum first.
• If it doesn't help, use RTCMemoryFixup with rtcfx_exclude= to find the bad region, then rtc-blacklist.
ts.p_sleep.title: Sleep doesn't work or wakes immediately
ts.p_sleep.cause: USB map, unsupported devices (Wi-Fi, NVMe, Thunderbolt), wake events or hibernation.
ts.p_sleep.fix:
• Map the USB ports first.
• Disable Wake on LAN and Wake on USB in the BIOS.
• Run the pmset commands below in macOS's Terminal.
• NVMe drives: NVMeFix.kext. Unused dGPU on laptops: disable it with an SSDT.
ts.p_amd_sleep.title: Sleep crashes on AMD
ts.p_amd_sleep.cause: The chipset USB controller ("Sleep transition timed out", suspect IOUSBHostFamily).
ts.p_amd_sleep.fix:
• Check the wake reason with the command below.
• Disable the chipset USB controller with an SSDT (_STA = 0), or fix the USBX power properties.
ts.p_nvme_sleep.title: NVMe drive breaks sleep or battery life
ts.p_nvme_sleep.cause: Non-Apple NVMe drives lack proper power management.
ts.p_nvme_sleep.fix: • Add NVMeFix.kext and update the drive's firmware (especially Samsung 970 EVO Plus).
ts.p_wake.title: Screens don't wake from sleep (Intel iGPU)
ts.p_wake.fix: • Add igfxonln=1 and keep WhateverGreen up to date.
ts.p_drm.title: DRM content doesn't play (Apple TV+, Netflix in Safari)
ts.p_drm.cause: iGPUs can't do Apple's hardware DRM; AMD cards need WhateverGreen's fixes and a matching SMBIOS.
ts.p_drm.fix:
• AMD Polaris or newer: try unfairgva=1 (Big Sur and newer) with an iMacPro1,1 or MacPro7,1 SMBIOS.
• Chrome and Firefox don't use hardware DRM and work without fixes.
ts.p_amd_apps.title: Some apps crash on AMD
ts.p_amd_apps.fix:
• Adobe: use the patches from adobe.amd-osx.com.
• Hypervisor-based VMs (Parallels, recent VMware) and Docker Desktop don't work; VirtualBox does.
ts.p_sensors.title: No temperature or fan readings
ts.p_sensors.cause: VirtualSMC's sensor kexts don't support AMD.
ts.p_sensors.fix: • AMD: SMCAMDProcessor (included by the app) and the AMD Power Gadget app.
ts.p_battery.title: Battery percentage missing or wrong (laptops)
ts.p_battery.cause: The EC exposes battery fields wider than 8 bits, which macOS can't read.
ts.p_brightness.title: No brightness control on dual-GPU laptops
ts.p_brightness.cause: Since macOS 11.3 backlight control goes to the dGPU in hybrid mode.
ts.p_brightness.fix:
• Keep SSDT-PNLF.
• Add @0,backlight-control, applbkl, AAPL,backlight-control and AAPL00,backlight-control = 01000000 to the iGPU and 00000000 to the dGPU, or disable one GPU.
ts.p_startup_disk.title: "You can't change the startup disk to the selected disk"
ts.p_startup_disk.cause: Windows' EFI partition is not the first on the drive.
ts.p_wrong_time.title: macOS wakes up with the wrong time
ts.p_wrong_time.cause: The RTC stops ticking during sleep.
ts.p_wrong_time.fix: • Replace the CMOS battery (Z270 and newer are picky about its voltage).
ts.p_sip.title: A tool asks to disable SIP
ts.p_sip.cause: Some patches and unsigned kexts need System Integrity Protection off.
ts.p_sip.fix:
• Set csr-active-config (03000000 disables kext signing and filesystem protection).
• Values with CSR_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_ROOT can break macOS updates.
ts.p_memory_macpro.title: "Memory modules misconfigured" on MacPro7,1
ts.p_memory_macpro.cause: macOS expects the real Mac Pro's memory layout.
ts.p_memory_macpro.fix: • Add RestrictEvents.kext to hide the warning.
ts.m_windows_time.title: Clock is wrong after switching between macOS and Windows
ts.m_windows_time.cause: macOS keeps the hardware clock in UTC, Windows in local time.
ts.m_windows_time.fix: • Tell Windows to use UTC: run the command below in an administrator Command Prompt.
ts.m_windows_missing.title: Windows doesn't show in the picker
ts.m_windows_missing.cause: Windows installed in legacy (MBR) mode, or ScanPolicy hides it.
ts.m_windows_missing.fix:
• Windows must be a UEFI/GPT install.
• Set ScanPolicy to 0.
• Same drive as OpenCore: enable Misc → Boot → HideSelf.
ts.m_windows_bsod.title: Windows blue screen (0xc000000d) or Linux crashes when booted from OpenCore
ts.m_windows_bsod.cause: Memory alignment on firmware with Memory Attribute Tables.
ts.m_windows_bsod.fix: • Turn on Booter → Quirks → SyncRuntimePermissions (if the OpenCore log says MAT support is 1).
ts.m_already_started.title: "OCB: StartImage failed - Already started" booting Windows
ts.m_already_started.cause: OpenCore thinks it is booting itself when it boots Windows.
ts.m_already_started.fix: • Move Windows to its own drive, or add its bootloader path under Misc → BlessOverride.
ts.m_resolution.title: Wrong or low resolution in the OpenCore picker
ts.m_resolution.fix:
• Turn on HiDPI boot screens (UIScale 2, Resolution Max).
• If ConsoleMode Max fails, leave it empty.
ts.m_bootcamp_apfs.title: Windows' Startup Disk can't see APFS drives
ts.m_bootcamp_apfs.fix: • Install the Boot Camp 6.1 drivers (Boot Camp Assistant in macOS, or CorpNewt's brigadier fork).
